option.name: --atversion
tip: Specify an LVM version in x.y.z format where x is the major version, the y is the minor version and z is the patchlevel (e.g. 2.2.106).

option.name: --commandprofile
tip: The command profile to use for command configuration.

option.name: --config
tip: Config settings for the command.

option.name: --debug
tip: Set debug level.

option.name: --devices
tip: Restricts the devices that are visible and accessible to the command.

option.name: --devicesfile
tip: A file listing devices that LVM should use.

option.name: --driverloaded
tip: If set to no, the command will not attempt to use device-mapper.

option.name: --file
tip: Write output to the named file.

option.name: --help
tip: Display help text.

option.name: --ignoreadvanced
tip: Exclude advanced configuration settings from the output.

option.name: --ignorelocal
tip: Ignore the local section.

option.name: --ignoreunsupported
tip: Exclude unsupported configuration settings from the output.

option.name: --journal
tip: Record information in the systemd journal.

option.name: --list
tip: List config settings with summarizing comment.

option.name: --lockopt
tip: Used to pass options for special cases to lvmlockd.

option.name: --longhelp
tip: Display long help text.

option.name: --mergedconfig
tip: When the command is run with --config and/or --commandprofile (or using LVM_COMMAND_PROFILE environment variable), --profile, or --metadataprofile, merge all the contents of the "config cascade" before displaying it.

option.name: --metadataprofile
tip: The metadata profile to use for command configuration.

option.name: --nohints
tip: Do not use the hints file to locate devices for PVs.

option.name: --nolocking
tip: Disable locking.

option.name: --profile
tip: An alias for --commandprofile or --metadataprofile, depending on the command.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress output and log messages.

option.name: --showdeprecated
tip: Include deprecated configuration settings in the output.

option.name: --showunsupported
tip: Include unsupported configuration settings in the output.

option.name: --sinceversion
tip: Specify an LVM version in x.y.z format where x is the major version, the y is the minor version and z is the patchlevel (e.g. 2.2.106).

option.name: --test
tip: Run in test mode.

option.name: --typeconfig
tip: Type of configuration settings to display.

option.name: --unconfigured
tip: Internal option used for generating config file during build.

option.name: --validate
tip: Validate current configuration used and exit with appropriate return code.

option.name: --valuesonly
tip: When printing config settings, print only values without keys.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Set verbose level.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version information.

option.name: --withcomments
tip: Display a full comment for each configuration node.

option.name: --withgeneralpreamble
tip: Include general config file preamble.

option.name: --withlocalpreamble
tip: Include local config file preamble.

option.name: --withspaces
tip: Where appropriate, add more spaces in output for better readability.

option.name: --withsummary
tip: Display a one line comment for each configuration node.

option.name: --withversions
tip: Also display a comment containing the version of introduction for each configuration node.

option.name: --yes
tip: Do not prompt for confirmation interactively but always assume the answer yes.
